meta.subtitle: Tap a question — no typing needed.
meta.intro: Tap a question below and I'll answer it right here.
meta._editorNote: Every answer a guest can see lives in this file. All content here is verified Grace Church information — nothing is placeholder. Only two routes are configured, /plan-your-visit/ and /giving/; there is deliberately no 'default' route, so the widget renders nothing on every other page. Adding a question means adding real, confirmed information, never a best guess.

/plan-your-visit/.intro: Glad you're planning a visit. Tap a question below and I'll answer it right here.

/giving/.intro: Tap a question below and I'll answer it right here.

service-times.label: When are your services?
answer: Spanish translation is available at the Sunday 12:30pm service, and the 9:20am Sunday service streams live online.

what-to-wear.label: What should I wear?
answer: Come as you are. Jeans, shorts, business casual — it all fits in here.

parking.label: Where do I park?
answer: Parking signs and a volunteer parking team will guide you in when you arrive.
Plan on getting here about 20 minutes early so you have time to park and get where you're going without rushing.

kids.label: What's here for my kids?
answer: GraceKids is for children from birth through 4th grade.
Every GraceKids volunteer is background-checked and Ministry Safe trained.
Check-in is secure: you and your child get matching tags, and your child is only released to the person holding the matching tag.

nursing-room.label: Is there a nursing moms' room?
answer: Yes — there's a dedicated Mother & Baby Room available.

quieter-space.label: Is there a quieter place to sit?
answer: Yes. There's an overflow area in the foyer for anyone who finds crowds or lights difficult.

spanish-service.label: Do you have a Spanish service?
answer: Spanish translation is available at our Sunday 12:30pm service.

watch-online.label: Can I watch online?
answer: Yes — our 9:20am Sunday service streams live online.

where-we-are.label: Where are you located?
answer: We're at 2300 Pembrook Drive, Orlando, FL 32810.

call-us.label: Can I call the church?
answer: Yes — the church phone number is 407-418-1300.

how-to-give.label: How do I give?
answer: You can give online, by text, or in the Grace app.
The giving page has what you need for each of those.
